description: China's growth has created demand for goods and services from around the world, strengthened global supply chains and contributed significantly to international economic growth. China's demand has supported Australia's mining industry, agriculture sector, higher education, and tourism industries as well, Australian scholar Brendan Augustin has said. #GLOBALink
title: GLOBALink | China's growth fuels Australia's economic prosperity: Australian scholar

author: New China TV
description: On Thursday night, a National Day celebration event was held in Yuxi, China's Yunnan. A mother, anxious to use restroom, asked a police officer for help. The officer held the kid while waiting for the mother to return. #China #Yunnan #NationalDay #Police #Heartwarming #Kindness
title: Police officer babysits kid for mother in need

author: New China TV
description:
At 8 p.m. on Oct. 1, a spectacular fireworks show illuminated the night sky over Wuhan, lighting up both banks of the #YangtzeRiver in a dazzling celebration of China's National Day.
Brilliant bursts of color reflected on the river as crowds watched the breathtaking display, filling the city with a festive atmosphere.
Catch the stunning moments from Wuhan and experience the celebration along the Yangtze!
title: Fireworks light up the Yangtze River in Wuhan for China's National Day

author: New China TV
description: China's longest undersea highway tunnel completed all shield-driven excavation work on Friday as a shield machine reached its designated position at a depth of 105 meters beneath the sea surface in Jiaozhou Bay, eastern China's Shandong Province, according to China Railway Construction Corporation Limited. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China's longest undersea highway tunnel completes shield tunneling

author: New China TV
description: The death toll from the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000, with 4,018 deaths reported among 8,300 confirmed cases across seven provinces, the latest figures released Friday by Congolese health authorities showed. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Ebola death toll in DR Congo tops 4,000

description:

At Snack Kingdom in Changsha, China, the world's largest snack store, foreign travelers came for Chinese snacks and faced one big problem: too many choices!
Noodles, spicy treats, biscuits and more -- what would be in your China Haul?
#ChinaHaul #ChineseSnacks #Changsha #China #TravelChina

title: Manneken-Pis dons Chinese attire for China's National Day

description: China's railway network handled 25.204 million passenger trips on Oct. 1, the first day of the week-long National Day holiday, setting a new single-day record, China State Railway Group Co., Ltd. (China Railway) said Friday. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | China's railway passenger trips hit record single-day high

description: SpaceX's Dragon spacecraft carrying four astronauts for NASA's Crew-13 mission docked with the International Space Station (ISS) on Thursday, after a nearly eight-hour journey from launch to the orbiting laboratory. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | SpaceX Dragon spacecraft carrying 4 astronauts docks with ISS

author: New China TV
description:
Around 100,000 vehicles in one day. 
Wuzhuang Toll Station in east China's Anhui Province saw a huge surge in traffic on the first day of China's seven-day National Day holiday.
Known as China's largest expressway toll station, it is a major gateway between Anhui and Jiangsu.
#China #NationalDay #HolidayTravel #Expressway #Traffic
title: A busy start at China's largest toll station

author: New China TV
description:
On China's National Day, a man carried the Chinese national flag to Gunzhongkou, a scenic spot in Ningxia.
As the flag caught the morning wind, fellow tourists stopped to watch and cheer.
There was no stage, no formal ceremony -- just people coming together on a holiday to celebrate their country with pride.
#ChinaNationalDay #NationalDay #HelanMountain #Ningxia #China
title: A proud National Day moment

author: New China TV
description:
Looking for a cultural getaway during the National Day holiday?
Tucked into a bend of the Yellow River, the Bingling Temple Grottoes are a treasure trove of ancient Buddhist art along the historic Silk Road.
Join Xinhua's Wang Zixuan as she explores this UNESCO World Heritage site in northwest China's Gansu Province.
#NationalDayHoliday #SilkRoad #CaveArt #BuddhistArt #WorldHeritage #ChinaTravel
title: Exploring Bingling Temple Grottoes in NW China's Gansu
